current_audit_context.scope: Final evaluation completed after corrected development, protocol freeze and integrity checks, without further tuning. The final set was protected during development.
current_audit_context.clock_alignment: Raw replay game_time differs from combat log timestamp through pauses. Snapshot construction uses safe preceding combat timestamp anchors.
current_audit_context.team_assignment: Replay slot order does not reliably indicate Radiant or Dire. Match observed hero names through pinned OpenDota identifiers to metadata drafts. Require ten distinct heroes, five per team. Exclude blank hero names.
current_audit_context.withdrawn_diagnostics: Earlier invalid development diagnostics were withdrawn to local excluded cache. Corrected development analyses and integrity checks preceded final evaluation. Withdrawn diagnostics are not retained as findings.
current_audit_context.provenance: Data audit findings supplied by the running implementation audit on 29 October 2026. These are not findings from the cited papers.
